zh.title: Wave Tank：波浪水箱
zh.summary: 在三维水箱里制造波浪，看水流与沙滩球一起运动。
zh.action: 选择水流场景，拖动水或调整重力、黏度等参数。
zh.why: 轻盈的交互让流体模拟像一个可以随手试验的小玩具。
zh.limit: 画面表现依赖设备的图形能力，模拟结果仅供探索。

en.title: Wave Tank
en.summary: Make waves in a 3D tank and watch the water and beach ball move.
en.action: Choose a scene, drag the water, or adjust gravity and viscosity.
en.why: A playful interface makes fluid simulation inviting to explore.
en.limit: Performance depends on graphics hardware; the simulation is for exploration.

alt.zh: 透明水槽里有蓝色水流和沙滩球，右侧是模拟参数。
alt.en: Blue water and a beach ball in a transparent tank beside simulation controls.

verification.note: Grok Bot 报告在桌面浏览器观察到水体流动与球体运动；手机未核验。
verification.note_en: Grok Bot reported observing the water and ball move in a desktop browser; mobile was not tested.

zh.title: Heart and Blood：心脏与循环
zh.summary: 观察三维心脏剖面，跟随课程了解心脏和血液循环。
zh.action: 进入第一课，选择 Look inside 查看剖面，再点 Next 浏览下一部分。
zh.why: 课程把三维模型、文字和互动练习放在一起。
zh.limit: AI 创作方式尚未确认；仅测试第一课部分操作，其他课程和手机体验未测。

en.title: Heart and Blood
en.summary: Inspect a 3D heart cross-section and follow lessons on the heart and circulation.
en.action: Enter the first lesson, choose Look inside, then select Next to continue.
en.why: A 3D model, text and interactive exercises come together in one lesson.
en.limit: AI creation has not been confirmed; only part of the first lesson was tested. Other lessons and mobile are unverified.

verification.note: 本机桌面审核进入第一课、查看剖面并打开练习；其余课程、声音和手机未测。
verification.note_en: In a local desktop browser, the reviewer entered the first lesson, opened the cross-section and opened the exercise; other lessons, audio and mobile were not tested.

alt.zh: 心脏三维模型悬在血液循环示意图上方，右侧是课程说明。
alt.en: A 3D heart above a circulation diagram with a lesson panel alongside.

zh.title: WeduLab：VoltLab 电路实验台
zh.summary: 在 WeduLab 的电路实验台上连接元件，观察电压和电流。
zh.action: 打开实验后选择示例，点击 S1 开关，观察示波器读数变化。
zh.why: 电路与测量仪器放在同一工作台上，便于边动手边理解。
zh.limit: 这个具体实验的 AI 创作方式尚未确认；仅测试一个电路，手机体验未测。

en.title: WeduLab: VoltLab Circuit Lab
en.summary: Connect components and observe voltage and current at WeduLab’s circuit workbench.
en.action: Open an example and toggle switch S1 to observe the oscilloscope readings.
en.why: A circuit and its measuring instruments share one workbench for hands-on learning.
en.limit: AI creation of this specific lab has not been confirmed; one circuit was tested and mobile is unverified.

verification.note: 本机桌面审核在中文界面闭合 S1 并观察电流变化；英文入口可访问，手机未测。
verification.note_en: In a local desktop browser, the reviewer closed S1 in the Chinese interface and observed the current change; the English entry responded and mobile was not tested.

zh.title: Kartboard：纸板卡丁车
zh.summary: 驾驶纸板小车，在手工模型般的桌面赛道上比赛。
zh.action: 选择 Race、1 Player、Single Race 和赛道，再选择难度与赛车；用方向键或 WASD 驾驶。
zh.why: 纸板场景、桌面道具和可选赛车，把迷你赛道做成了一场轻快的浏览器比赛。
zh.limit: AI 参与创作的情况尚未确认，作为灵感参考收录。原作并未开放源码；首次加载可能较慢，需要支持 WebGPU 或 WebGL2 的浏览器。仅测试桌面单人比赛开局与短距离驾驶，手机和双人模式未测。

en.title: Kartboard
en.summary: Race a cardboard kart around a miniature tabletop track.
en.action: Choose Race, 1 Player, Single Race and a track, then choose a difficulty and kart. Drive with the arrow keys or WASD.
en.why: Cardboard scenery, desk props and a choice of karts turn a miniature course into a playful browser race.
en.limit: AI involvement has not been confirmed, so this is listed as a creative reference. The game itself is not open source. Initial loading may take time; a WebGPU or WebGL2 browser is required. Only the start of a solo race and a short drive were tested on desktop; mobile and two-player modes were not tested.

verification.note: 本机桌面浏览器进入单人比赛，选择 Desk GP、Easy 与赛车，比赛开始后按方向键短距离行驶；未完成单圈，手机、双人模式与声音未测。
verification.note_en: A local desktop browser entered a solo race, selected Desk GP, Easy and a kart, then drove briefly with the arrow keys. A full lap, mobile, two-player mode and audio were not tested.

alt.zh: Kartboard 的纸板赛道与主菜单，署名 Makio64。
alt.en: The Kartboard main menu over a miniature cardboard track, credited to Makio64.

zh.title: Kelp：海藻林中的光
zh.summary: 在海底森林中观察摇曳的海藻、鱼群与光线。
zh.action: 尝试移动指针或点击场景，也可以探索水流滑块和日光控制。
zh.why: 水下植物、鱼群与不断变化的光共同构成可以探索的海藻林。
zh.limit: AI 参与未确认，列为灵感参考。Grok Bot 在无 WebGPU 的环境中通过 WebGL 后备模式看到场景，帧率很低；日光控制、声音及手机未测。

en.title: Kelp: Light in a Kelp Forest
en.summary: Observe swaying kelp, fish and light in an underwater forest.
en.action: Try moving the pointer or clicking the scene, and explore the current slider and sun control.
en.why: Underwater plants, fish and changing light form an explorable kelp forest.
en.limit: AI involvement has not been verified, so this is an inspiration reference. In Grok Bot’s environment the WebGL fallback rendered at a very low frame rate; the sun control, audio and mobile were not tested.

verification.note: Grok Bot 在桌面浏览器通过 WebGL 后备模式看到海藻、鱼群与水流控件；点击场景后视角变化，帧率约 0–1 fps，日光控制与手机未测。
verification.note_en: Grok Bot saw kelp, fish and a current control in a desktop WebGL fallback; clicking changed the view. The frame rate was about 0–1 fps; the sun control and mobile were not tested.

alt.zh: 阳光穿过海水照亮海藻和鱼群，旁边有水流控制。
alt.en: Sunlight filters through a kelp forest and fish beside a current control.

zh.title: Kelp：纸船与海藻
zh.summary: 漂浮在光影流动的海面，观察纸船和水下海藻。
zh.action: 拖动视角，再点击水面放出纸船。
zh.why: 波光、海藻和纸船构成一幅可以轻轻改变视角的实时画面。
zh.limit: AI 参与未确认，列为灵感参考。Grok Bot 测试了桌面拖动与放纸船；声音及手机未测试。

en.title: Kelp: Paper Boats and Seaweed
en.summary: Float above a sea of shifting light, paper boats and underwater kelp.
en.action: Drag to look around, then click the water to launch a paper boat.
en.why: Ripples, kelp and paper boats form a real-time scene that responds to your view.
en.limit: AI involvement has not been verified, so this is an inspiration reference. Grok Bot tested dragging and launching boats on desktop; audio and mobile were not tested.

verification.note: Grok Bot 在桌面浏览器拖动后视角变化，点击后出现更多纸船；声音与手机未测。此作品与 Adam Chernick 的同名作品为不同项目。 预览图为 Grok Bot 于 2026-11-18 的桌面实测截图。
verification.note_en: Grok Bot changed the desktop view by dragging and launched more paper boats by clicking; audio and mobile were not tested. This is distinct from Adam Chernick’s work of the same name. The preview is from Grok Bot’s desktop test on 18 November 2026.

alt.zh: 数只纸船漂浮在绿色的海藻与水面上。
alt.en: Paper boats float above green kelp in the water.

provenance.note: The screenshot was captured by Grok Bot during the desktop test on 2026-11-18.
